title: Sell declared electrical articles only if approved
what: Sell a declared electrical article only if its model is approved (in NSW or by another state's authority), and sell electrical articles only if marked and compliant.

sources.title: Gas and Electricity (Consumer Safety) Act 2017 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not sell a declared electrical article if the article is not of— (a) a model of electrical article that has a model approval, or (b) a class, description or model that has been approved or registered by the relevant authority for another State or a Territory, or

administration.who: Secretary of the Ministry of Health (NSW)
